frames.title: Lesson 13 · Not only… but also — inversion — production and review

body: **Foco:** Not only… but also — inversion — produção e revisão.
**Verbos:** advocate.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** texto acadêmico e resumo.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir e revisar um resumo acadêmico com inversão (Not only…, Not until…, Little did…) e usar advocate.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Abstract: Corporate Transparency and Trust
paras: This paper examines whether transparency improves trust in firms. **Not only do** transparent firms attract investors, **but they also** retain employees longer. **Not until** reporting rules were tightened **did** these effects become measurable.
The authors **advocate** mandatory disclosure, **although** they concede that **little can be said** about small enterprises. Further research is needed.

items.q: The effects appeared before reporting rules were tightened.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Not only do transparent firms attract investors, but they also retain staff.**
**Not until rules were tightened did effects appear.**

blocks.body: Revise suas frases: (1) inverteu **auxiliar + sujeito**? (2) manteve o **paralelismo**? (3) usou **did** no passado simples?

items.s: Not only ___ transparent firms attract investors. (do)
Not until rules were tightened ___ effects become measurable. (did)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Come to light.** — Vir à tona.
**Open the books.** — Abrir as contas.
**Above board.** — Transparente.
**Under scrutiny.** — Sob escrutínio.
**Call for greater transparency.** — Exigir mais transparência.
**Lay one’s cards on the table.** — Colocar as cartas na mesa.
**Shed light on.** — Esclarecer.
**Cast doubt on.** — Lançar dúvida sobre.
**Do the authors advocate disclosure?** — Os autores defendem a divulgação?
**Not only do transparent firms attract investors, they also retain staff.** — Empresas transparentes não só atraem investidores, como retêm funcionários.
**Not until reporting rules were tightened did the effects appear.** — Só depois que as regras de relato foram endurecidas os efeitos apareceram.

blocks.title: Journal club
lines: Not only do transparent firms attract investors, they also retain staff.
Empresas transparentes não só atraem investidores, como retêm funcionários.
Not until reporting rules were tightened did the effects appear.
Só depois que as regras de relato foram endurecidas os efeitos apareceram.
Yes, although little can be said about small firms.
Sim, embora pouco se possa dizer das pequenas empresas.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: Not only do firms profit, but they also grow.
Not until May did sales rise.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence abstract on a topic of your choice using at least three inversion structures.
blocks.model: This paper examines whether remote work improves productivity. Not only do remote workers report higher satisfaction, but they also complete more tasks. Not until managers adopted clear goals did results become consistent. Seldom have studies compared small and large firms. The authors advocate flexible policies and further research.
